verdict.rationale: The evidence documents model search and download via Hugging Face, plus a chat and agent interface (Bionic). Nothing shows an AI assistant that recommends a model based on the user's hardware and task before download. Search/download and a general agent are adjacent features, not the recommendation capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
